question: Formal email kaise likhein?
answer: Formal email mein saaf subject, namr greeting, chhota aur spasht sandesh, zaroori action ya deadline, aur apna naam/sign-off rakhein. Bhejne se pehle spelling aur attachment check karein.

question: Short summary kaise likhein?
answer: Summary mein source ka main point aur zaroori supporting points apne shabdon mein likhein. Repeated details aur apni taraf se naye claims na jodein.

question: Job ke liye chhota application email likho
answer:
Subject: Application for [Job Title]

Dear [Name],
I am writing to apply for the [Job Title] position. My experience in [relevant skill] may be a good match for this role. I have attached my resume for your review.

Thank you for your time.
Regards,
[Your Name]

question: Paragraph ka main idea kaise pehchanein?
answer: Paragraph mein baar-baar aane wale vishay aur writer ke mukhya daave ko dekhein. Aksar topic sentence main idea batata hai; examples aam taur par usse samjhate hain.

question: Hindi mein chhoti chhutti ki application kaise likhein?
answer: Ek saral format: “Seva mein, [adhikari/teacher ka naam]. Vishay: Chhutti ke liye nivedan. Mahoday/Mahodaya, mujhe [kaarana] se [tareekh] ko chhutti chahiye. Kripya anumati dein. Dhanyavaad, [aapka naam].” Apni sahi jaankari bharein.
